task: For each single-domain complaint, apply the shared UDRP and interpretive environment to the supplied procedural history, factual background and attributed party contentions. Decide whether transfer or cancellation relief is warranted. Output RELIEF_GRANTED, DENIED or ABSTAIN with evidence.
scope: Retrospective prediction from published pre-analysis sections; not original complaint/annexes or prospective legal advice.
constraints: No access to current decision/analysis or online case-result search
Historical cases quoted by parties may remain; source attribution must be preserved
Private labels are provisional extraction, not model resources
Directory layout is not OS isolation
